s: Hilkot birkot hashshachar ushear berakot ubo y"a seipim: birkot hashshachar tiqqenum chakamim al seder haolam vehanhagato mah shehabberiyyot nehenin bekol yom, sheyyebareku lehaqqadosh baruk hu al zeh bepaam rishona shennehenin hanaa zo, bekol yom vayom, lehashlim minyan hammea berakot shechayyab kol adam lebarek bekol yom vayom meereb vead boqer, kemo shettiqqen david hammelek alayv hashshalom, al yede maaseh shehayu metim bekol yom mea nepashot miyyisrael velo hayu yodeim al ma hayu metim, ad shechaqar vehebin beruach haqqodesh, vetiqqen mea berakot bekol yom. Veremez laddabar "neum haggeber huqam al", "al" begimatriyya q'. Vesemek laddabar min hattora "veatta yisrael ma Hashem eloheka shoel meimmak ki im leyira et Hashem", al tiqre "ma" ella "mea". Vehen mea berakot, shehen leyira et Hashem uleahaba oto ulezokro tamid, al yede habberakot shemmebarek tamid ereb vaboqer vetzohorayim beg' tepillot ubirkot hashshachar ushear berakot haqqebuot bekol yom ubekol et. Vehen q' berakot ap beyom hattaanit: n"z beg' tepillot, ub' lipne qeriat shema shel arbit veg' leachareha im "yiru enenu" — hare s"b. Ubisudat hallayla mebarek ch' berakot: "al netilat yadayim" ve"hammotzi" ved' shel birkat hammazon, veal kos shebbebirkat hammazon mebarek lepanayv uleacharayv — hare a'. Veachar kak "birkat hammappil" kesheholek lishon, ve"al netilat yadayim" bashshachar, va"asher yatzar" ve"elohay neshama" — hare a"d. Vet"v berakot me"hannoten lassekvi" ad "haggomel chasadim tobim" — hare p"t. Veg' birkot hattora, ub' shel tepillin, veachat shel tzitzit, u"baruk sheamar", ve"yishtabbach", ushettayim lipne qeriat shema veachat leachareha — hare q'. Ubeshabbat chaseru mig' tepillot — l"v berakot, ub' berakot shel tepillin, ubirkat "yiru enenu". Venittosepu z' shel musap, vet"z shel b' seudot, ub' shel qiddush hallayla keshemmeqaddesh al hakkos, veachat shel qiddush hayyom — hare k"v. Chaseru y"g — tzarik lemallotan beperot umine besamim. Veim en lo — yekavven veyishma birkot haqqorein battora vehammaptir veyaaneh acharehen amen, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rp"d. Abal im lo yishma habberaka, ap al pi sheyyodea ezeh beraka mebarek veoneh achareha amen — enah ola lo leminyan q' berakot. Abal mi sheyyesh lo perot — eno yotze bishmiat habberakot. Ubeyom hakkippurim yakol lehariach ulemallovat minyan q' berakot, ak i epshar lebarek al kol paam im lo behessach haddaat, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"z, vehashshear yekavven bishmiat habberakot bachazarat hashsheliach tzibbur. Veken yaaseh mi shemmitanneh mibbeod yom, shechaseru lo ch' shel seudat hallayla:

Birkot hashshachar nitqenu lebarek kol achat beshaa shennitchayyeb bah. Dehaynu, kesheyyeor mishshenato — yomar "elohay neshama". Ukesheshshomea qol hattarnegol — yebarek "hannoten lassekvi bina". Ukeshellobesh chaluqo vehu mushkab — yebarek "malbish arummim". Ukesheyyanniach yado al enayv derek chaluq (abal shello derek hechaluq asur lehoshit yad laayin qodem netilat yadayim kemo shennitbaer besiman d') — yebarek "poqeach ivrim". Ukesheyyosheb — yebarek "mattir asurim", mippene shemmenia atzmotayv shehayu kol hallayla kemo keputim, ukeshezzoqep — yebarek zoqep kepupim, shehayeta qomato kepupa kol hallayla veakshav omda al maamadah. Ukesheyyanniach raglayv baaretz — yebarek "roqa haaretz al hammayim". Ukeshennoel minalayv — yebarek "sheasa li kol tzorki". Veen leshannot hannussach velomar "tzerakai" — hakka"p beqamatz, shehu leshon rabbim, mippene shebberaka zo eno ella al neilat minalim shehu tzorek haadam (veal shear tzerakayv — mebarek alehem bipne atzmo keshennehena mehem). Ukesheholek — yebarek "hammekin mitzade gaber". Veyesh nohagin lomar "asher hekin". Ukeshechoger chagoro o lobesh haabnet hammapsiq beno laerva — yebarek "ozer yisrael bigbura". Ukeshemmesim koba o mitznepet berosho — yebarek "oter yisrael betipara". Velamma huzkeru shem yisrael beb' berakot ellu velo baacherot? Lepi shehachagora vehakkoba beyisrael enam kemo baummot, shebbaummot enan ella lahanaat haggup bilbad, abal beyisrael hem gam ken mishshum tzeniut uqedushsha, hachagora — lehapsiq ben libbo laerva, vehakkoba — shello yehe begilluy harosh, veap sheen issur bazeh min haddin, mikkol maqom middat tzeniut uqedushsha hu, sheal yede kak mamshik mora shamayim al rosho. Ukeshennotel yadayv — yebarek "al netilat yadayim". Ukeshennotel panayv — yebarek "hammaabir shena meenai veku' vihi ratzon ku' ad baruk atta Hashem gomel chasadim tobim leammo yisrael". Veen laanot amen achar "hammaabir shena meenai" qodem "vihi ratzon", mippene shehakkol beraka achat arukka — potachat be"baruk" vechotemet be"baruk". Veap al pi shetztzarik lomar hachatima meen happeticha, yesh lomar she"gomel chasadim tobim" hu hachesed sheoseh haqqadosh baruk hu shemmaabir cheble shena meenayv:

Akshav mippene sheen hayyadayim neqiyyot vegam mippene amme haaratzot sheenam yodeim otan — nahagu lesadderan bebet hakkeneset vehem onin acharehen amen veyotzeim yede chobatan, shebberakot ellu enan domin lebirkot hammitzvot shetztzarik lebarek ober laasiyyatan, lepi shemmebarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu laasot", abal berakot hallalu shehen shebach vehodaa — yakol lebarek otan gam achar kak. Vaapillu shama qol tarnegol bachatzot — yakol lebarek alayv bashshachar, kevan shelleachar mikken mebarek — lo natenu bahem chakamim shiur tekipa:

Veod g' berakot shechayyab adam lebarek bekol yom: "shello asani goy" ve"shello asani abed" ve"shello asani ishsha". Vaapillu hashshabuy yomar "shello asani abed", sheen habberaka al hacherut mehaabdut, ella al sheen haebed chayyab ella bemitzvot shehaishsha chayyebet bahem. Veger — yesh omerim sheyyomar "sheasani ger", ki keshennaasa ger hu keqatan shennolad venaasa beriyya vaasiyya chadasha. Abal lo yomar "shello asani goy", shehare haya goy bitchillat asiyyato. Veap al pi ken yomar "shello asani abed". Veap al pi shehaya nokri vegarua meebed, mikkol maqom haya yakol lehitgayyer ulehitchayyeb bekol hammitzvot. Abal im haya ebed — lo haya yakol lehishtachrer, ella im ken shichrero rabbo. Veyesh omerim sheen lo lebarek "sheasani ger", ki nitgayyer al yede bechirato shebbachar bedat yisrael. Ulepi dibre hamqubbalim shebberakot ellu hen al yetziat nishmato ballayla shello nidbaq bah nishmat goy o ebed o ishsha — gam hagger yakol lebarek ken. Vehannashim nohagot lebarek "sheasani kirtzono", vehu kemo shemmatzdiq alayv et haddin al haraa:

Keshemmesadderin otan bebet hakkeneset — yesh lesadderan keseder shemmitchayyebin bahen kol maqom umaqom lepi minhago. Kegon bimqomot sheen holekin yachep kelal venoalim minalim techilla veachar kak holekin — mebarek techilla "haoseh li kol tzorki" veachar kak "hammekin mitzade gaber". Ubimqomot sheholekin qetzat yachep betok habbayit veachar kak noalin kesheyyotzein lashshuq — mebarekin "hammekin mitzade gaber techilla" (veken leinyan "poqeach ivrim" u"malbish arummim"). Veim taa beseder habberakot — en bekak kelum, chutz mibbirkat "mattir asurim" ve"zoqep kepupim", sheim berak "zoqep kepupim" — lo yachazor vibarek "mattir asurim", mippene shebbiklal zeqipat haqqoma hu hattarat haebarim utenuatam, velamma yachazor lebarek al zeh shenit. Abal im berak techilla "shello asani abed" — yachazor lebarek "shello asani goy" ap shehaggoy garua mehaebed, lepi sheyyesh maala baggoy sheenah baebed, shehaebed en lo yichus, sheen zaro meyuchas acharayv ella achare haem kemo bibhema, shenneemar: "shebu lakem poh im hachamor — am haddomeh lachamor", mah sheen ken benokri. Vegam, hannokri yakol lehitgayyer meatzmo velihyot keyisrael gamur, mah sheen ken baebed. Veken im berak techilla "shello asani ishsha" — yachazor lebarek "shello asani goy veebed", shehaishsha enah yekola lehitchayyeb bekol hammitzvot kemo nokri sheyyitgayyer veebed sheyyeshachrero rabbo, vetzarik litten hodaa lammaqom baruk hu shello sam chelqo kamulleh shebbahem, ella zaka laabod Hashem velihyot qarob elayv yoter mikkullam:

Bimdinot ellu nohagin lebarek "hannoten layyaep koach". Vetiqqenuhu haggeonim achar chatimat hattalmud, mippene tashshut koach sheyyorda laolam, ubekol yom mitchaddesh kocho shel adam, ukemo sheameru: "chadashim labbeqarim rabba emunateka", basar vadam mapqid piqqadon etzel chabero vehu machaziro baluy umequlqal, vekol adam mapqid nishmato etzel haqqadosh baruk hu leet ereb ayepa vehu machazirah lo chadasha uregua, verau haggeonim letaqqen beraka al hachesed haggadol hazzeh. Veyesh mepaqpeqim leomrah, mippene sheen koach beyad shum adam letaqqen beraka achar chatimat hattalmud. Veen bazeh keday lidchot hamminhag vetaqqanat haggeonim (abal beraka shello tiqqenuha haggeonim, o shello nitpashsheta taqqanatam velo nahagu bah rob hatztzibbur — en leomrah kelal ledibre hakkol. Velaken tzarik limchot beyad hammadpisim shello lehadpis "baruk atta Hashem" besop kamma techinnot ubaqqashot, ki hen berakot lebattala ledibre hakkol). Veken mah sheyyesh nohagin lebarek bashshachar berakot acherot nosapot, kegon "baruk somek nopelim" "baruk magbiah shepalim" taut hu beyadam veen leomram kelal:

Kol birkot hashshachar im lo nitchayyeb beechad mehen, kegon shello shama qol tarnegol, o shello halak, o shello labash, o shello chagar (o shehaya neor kol hallayla velo hutzrak lehaabir cheble shena meenayv), yesh omerim sheotah beraka shello nitchayyeb bah — lo yomrenna. Veyesh omerim shekkol habberakot shehen al sidduro shel olam vehanhagato, kegon "hannoten lassekvi bina" ve"roqa haaretz" — mebarek otan ap al pi shello nitchayyeb bahen, abal habberakot shehen lahanaato kegon "malbish arummim" ve"hammekin mitzade gaber" ve"ozer yisrael bigbura" ve"oter yisrael" im lo nitchayyeb bahen, kegon sheshshokeb al mittato arom — lo yomren kelal. Veyesh omerim sheapillu lo nitchayyeb bahen kelal — yebarek kullan kesidran, mippene sheen habberakot al hanaat atzmo bilbad, ella mebarekin shehaqqadosh baruk hu bara tzorke haolam, veim hu eno nehena — acherim nehenin. Veken hamminhag pashut veen leshannot. Veyesh mi sheomer sheap al pi ken suma lo yebarek "poqeach ivrim", kevan shehu dabar hechaser begupo. Abal cheresh yebarek "hannoten lassekvi bina", kevan sheshshemiat haozen enah muzkeret babberaka. Ulekattechilla tob lehabi atzmo lide chiyyub kol habberakot, im epshar lo (veim i epshar bekullan, al kol panim yesh lo lelek velilbosh velachgor uleatter qodem sheyyesadder birkotehen, kede lachosh lisbara sheniyya):

Yesh meqomot shennohagin lesadder birkot hattora qodem parashat "tamid". Veap al pi sheomerim pesuqim harbeh qodem birkot hattora — en chosheshin lazeh, hoil veomerim otan derek tachanunim velo derek limmud uqeria battora. Abal yoter nakon minhag hannohagin lebarek miyyad achar "asher yatzar" ve"elohay neshama" (o achar "gomel chasadim tobim" vi"yahi ratzon ku'") qodem sheomerim shum pasuq min hammiqra. Ubime hasselichot yebarek birkat hattora qodem hasselichot vidallegenna achar kak. Veken yesh linhog bekol maqom. Veim yesh echad shello amarah adayin — yered lipne hatteba, veyomrenna achar kak bimqomot shennohagin leomrah lipne hatteba kede lehotzi et mi sheeno yodea. Veken yaaseh berosh hashshana veyom kippur:

Tob lomar beshacharit achar "shema yisrael vego'" — "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed", ki lipamim omerim hatztzibbur piyyutim be"yotzer" veshohin ad qeriat shema liqrotah shello bizmannah, veyotze bazeh ledibre haomerim sheppasuq rishon bilbad hu min hattora. Umikkol maqom, ap al pi sheomer ken bekol yom — lo yitkavven latzet yede chobato bazeh ella kesheyyare shehatztzibbur yaabru zeman qeriat shema, abal keshello yaabru — mutab latzet yede qeriat shema im hatztzibbur veliqrotah kedinah bebirkoteha velismok geulla litpilla. Ukesheyyare shehatztzibbur yaabru zeman qeriat shema — yesh lo liqrot kol happarasha rishona kede latzet yede chobato, lehaomerim shekkol happarasha harishona hu min hattora (ulehaomerim sheggam parashat "vehaya im shamoa vego'" hu min hattora — yesh liqrotah gam ken, vikavven sheim yaabru hatztzibbur zeman qeriat shema — yihyeh yotze bazeh, veim lav — yihyeh keqore battora). Abal zekirat yetziat mitzrayim ap al pi shemmitzvatah gam ken bizman qeriat shema, mikkol maqom yukal lismok al zekirat yetziat mitzrayim shebbipsuqe dezimra, kegon "anoki Hashem eloheka hammaalka meeretz mitzrayim":

Bimdinot ellu shennohagin lomar "atta hu ad shello nibra haolam ku'" — en leshannot hannuscha velomar "atta hu ad shello barata" (abal mah shennahagu lachtom "baruk atta h' meqaddesh ku'" — min harauy haya shello lachtom beshem, kevan shello huzkera beraka zo battalmud shellanu (vegam betalmud yerushalmi yesh sheen goresin bo hazkarat hashshem bachatimatah, vegam haggeonim lo matzinu shettiqqenu bah hazkarat hashshem kemo shettiqqenu be"hannoten layyaep koach"), ella kevan shennahagu — nahagu. Lepikak, harotzeh lizzaher shello lehaknis atzmo lispeq beraka lebattala — yapeh hu oseh):

Al pi hassod yesh lomar pasuq "vaani berob chasdeka" qodem boo lebet hakkeneset. Ubiknisato yomar "bebet elohim nehallek beragesh". Viqabbel alayv mitzvat aseh shel "veahabta lereaka kamoka" qodem tepilla. Veyesh mi sheqqabbala beyado lomar parasha "shema yisrael" kesheyyotze mibbeto lebet hakkeneset:
